# Regulatory Compliance and Fraud Analysis Review

This document outlines critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Review the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection for strategy 2026.
*   Conduct quarterly reviews of regulatory changes.
*   Update the standard procedures for regulatory changes.
*   Optimize regulatory changes based on audit recommendations.
*   Review legal risks identified during audits.
